**Why I stopped here:** the skill says only a clear verdict on the whole plan, against the approved revision, satisfies readiness. A verdict on a declared subset is evidence for that scope only, with no "subset or plateau waiver". Missing milestones count as unfinished implementation work, not as a waived requirement. Green CI and a "Review completed" CodeRabbit status don't change that.

I also posted no new assessment request (the skill forbids repeating one that was already answered) and queued no formal review, since that only comes after readiness.

**What's blocking it, and who owns it:**
- **Blocker:** milestones EP-M3 to EP-M6 of the `rev-7` plan are not implemented.
- **Owner:** the implementation owner (`sdlc-implementation`), or you, if the plan needs restructuring.
- **Next action:**
  - If this PR is meant to carry the whole plan, implement EP-M3 to EP-M6, then re-run gates and CI and post a follow-up assessment for the new head.
  - If it is one layer of a stack, split the plan into self-contained units first. A layer that covers only part of one undivided plan can never pass this gate.

This working directory has no repository checkout or helper manifest, so I couldn't hand off the implementation work from here.
